usage: framework itself; every component
user_pays_how: the app already owns it; never listed in component.json (installed-paths ignores it)
reasoning: The platform. Not replaceable. Policy: keep the workspace req at the oldest release we test, bump lock deliberately (0.7.10 exists).

name: dioxus-attributes
usage: 277 lines / 64 files in primitives/src (attribute-spread macro)
user_pays_how: proc-macro compiled for every primitives user (syn full+extra-traits, dioxus-rsx - already in dioxus' macro tree)
reasoning: Own crate, structural to every component; its deps (syn/quote/proc-macro2/dioxus-rsx) are already in dioxus' tree.

name: dioxus-sdk-time
usage: only `sleep` (7 files, 10 call sites); crate is 520 LOC, `sleep` = 4 lines (tokio::time on host / gloo_timers on wasm)
user_pays_how: in primitives' unconditional deps (+gloo-timers on wasm, +tokio on host, both reached only through it in primitives' tree)
reasoning: Tiny slice. Own `sleep` = tokio::time::sleep (host) + gloo_timers::future::sleep (wasm) ~15 lines, but it trades 1 crate for 2 direct deps (tokio, gloo-timers); net saving is futures+futures-executor+sdk-time (3 crates). Low priority, optional.

name: time
usage: public API type (`time::Date`, Month, Weekday, OffsetDateTime) of Calendar/DatePicker; 12 non-doc lines in 3 primitives files; 28 lines/23 files preview
user_pays_how: primitives unconditional dep (all users) + component.json of calendar, date_picker
reasoning: Hard to replace (it is our public date type, calendar math). But only Calendar/DatePicker need it, yet every primitives user compiles 6 extra crates. Gate behind a primitives feature (e.g. `calendar`) enabled by calendar/date_picker component.json `features`. `parsing` feature appears unused (no Date::parse/format_description in primitives) - candidate trim, unverified without a build.
effort: M (2-4h: cfg-gate calendar.rs/date_picker.rs/lib.rs LocalDateExt, update 2 component.json, preview features)

name: num-integer
usage: 1 import, used only as the trait bound `T: Integer` on the private DateSegment<T> generics in date_picker.rs
reasoning: Used as a bound only (no gcd/div_floor calls found). Replace with `Copy + Ord + FromStr + Display` or a 5-line private trait.

name: tracing
usage: primitives: 2 real call sites (`tracing::warn!` in selection.rs, carousel.rs); ~100 more are in rustdoc examples
user_pays_how: primitives dep, but dioxus already brings tracing -> 0 extra crates
reasoning: Zero marginal crates (dioxus depends on it). Replacing 2 warn! calls buys nothing.

name: serde
usage: primitives: 3 files (JSON payloads exchanged with JS via eval: virtual_list, message_scroller, js_listener); cli: manifest/lock
user_pays_how: primitives dep; already in dioxus tree -> 0 extra crates
reasoning: Standard; free in a Dioxus tree.

name: palette
usage: primitives: color_picker.rs + color_picker/color_naming.rs only (HSV<->sRGB, sRGB->Oklch); palette types (Hsv, Srgb<u8>) are in ColorPicker's PUBLIC props; preview 3 lines
user_pays_how: primitives unconditional dep (12 crates incl. rand 0.8, phf proc-macro for EVERY user) + component.json of color_picker. Note cargo add --no-default-features is applied (quirk) so palette's `std` is only on via primitives
reasoning: Largest single marginal cost (12 crates) for one component. Making `palette` optional behind a `color-picker` primitives feature (color_picker component.json adds `features:["color-picker"]`) removes it from every other app. A rewrite is possible (~150-250 LOC HSV/sRGB/OKLCH) but breaks the public prop types; gating is cheaper and non-breaking.
effort: S-M (1-3h gate; rewrite instead = L, API break)

name: lazy-js-bundle
usage: primitives/build.rs bundles ONE 112-line focus-trap.ts into a committed 1-line focus-trap.js
user_pays_how: build script compiled+run in EVERY user's build of primitives (git dep)
reasoning: Read from source: build.rs hashes src/ts with std DefaultHasher (not stable across Rust versions by contract) and if it differs from src/js/hash.txt shells out to `bun` and writes into the dependency checkout. On a user's machine without bun that is a build failure; with a stable hash it is a no-op that still costs a build-script compile. Commit the JS, drop build.rs, add a repo-side gate that the .js matches the .ts. (Risk is latent, not observed; hash stability across rustc is the unverified part.)

name: dioxus-icons
usage: 153 files in preview (demos); 25 shipped component.rs use 16 distinct Lucide icons (ChevronDown, Check, ChevronRight, X, Ellipsis, ...)
user_pays_how: component.json of 27 components (conditional, only when one is installed)
reasoning: Already correctly conditional. 1 crate, 1705 icon fns as static templates so wasm only carries icons used (estimate - not measured); crate source is 24 MB so first compile parses a lot (unverified cost). Replacing 16 icons with inline SVG (~200 LOC) is possible but users would lose the same icon family for their own UI. Consider exact `=0.1.0` pin (single release, young crate).

name: dioxus-code

reasoning: Docs-site tooling; 21 exclusive crates (arborium tree-sitter, toml_edit, regex...) never reach users. Young crate (9.6k downloads): pin and move on. Do NOT reuse it for a shipped markdown code-block highlighter without measuring (tree-sitter).

name: [component.json] dioxus-primitives
usage: every installed component
user_pays_how: all of: dioxus-attributes, sdk-time(+futures,+futures-executor,+gloo-timers/tokio), time(6), num-integer, palette(12) => ~22 crates beyond dioxus on wasm
reasoning: Floats on the registry's default-branch HEAD at the moment of `cargo add`. Stamp a `rev` at release time (dx's CargoDependency supports `rev`, not tag/branch). Note dx always passes --no-default-features, which rewrites an existing user dependency to default-features=false and so turns primitives' default `router` OFF (40 crates, ICU/url/sha2 via dioxus-router) except where navbar re-adds it.
